mechanismOfAction.summary: Presumed LSD prodrug via sequential deethylation (→ 1Bz-LAE) then hydrolysis → LSD; full chain characterized in vitro only.
mechanismOfAction.description: N1-benzoyl LSD (benzoyl = aromatic acyl group; distinct from 1B-LSD which is 1-butanoyl). In vitro: deethylation to 1Bz-LAE confirmed (Azuma et al. 2026, Drug Test Anal); further hydrolysis to LSD presumed. No validated human potency or dose range established.
